keys.bracketed_paste: capture ESC[200~ through ESC[201~ payload as a single paste transaction
keys.enter_in_preview: commit only if complete valid rectangle fits bounds
keys.ctrl_z: undo the most recently committed paste as one operation
keys.F2: export current grid JSON; destination set by command argument

paste_anchor: capture row_id and column id at opening bracketed-paste marker; preview does not change grid
framing: input may split UTF-8 and escape markers across reads; newline in quoted field is data, not an Enter command
display: current coordinate and current value; preview size, validity and errors indexed by logical source row/column; narrow terminals may show a safe size message but preserve state
scope: one pending preview and at least one undo; no redo, network validator, formula or virtual scrolling requirement
export: preserve row IDs and cell types exactly; failed/cancelled previews leave all values unchanged
